statement: WiiBrew's Wii Motion Plus introduction reports a host-game discovery behavior of trying the inactive MotionPlus ID registers repeatedly and waiting several seconds before another check if detection fails (example: three attempts followed by an eight-second delay). This describes observed or reverse-engineered host polling, not MotionPlus packet cadence or a mandatory virtual-device response latency.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew oldid 120079 introductory MotionPlus identification section; complement separately pinned Linux HZ*4 host periodic polling.
